items: ISS Expedition 75 under way: Crew-13 Dragon docked Oct 1, Crew-12 landed Oct 8
Cygnus NG-24 unberthed Oct 9 and burned up over the South Pacific Oct 12
Dragon CRS-35 docked Oct 15 carrying two IROSA solar arrays; EVA-100 on Oct 29 installed the 2A array on P4
Falcon Heavy launched NROL-97 from KSC on Oct 2
21 SDA Tranche 1 Transport Layer satellites launched Oct 10; USSF-481 flew Oct 16
Starlink Group 15 launches on Oct 13, 23, 27 and 31 from Vandenberg
JAXA H3 launched the MMX Phobos sample-return probe Oct 19; it left Earth's Hill sphere Oct 24; capsule due back at Woomera in 2031
China: Xingwang batches on CZ-12 and CZ-8A, Yaogan 50, 53 and 56 launches, Landspace Zhuque-2E orbital computing sats
Rocket Lab Electron launched three Hawk sigint satellites Oct 23
ISRO GSLV Mk II put NVS-03 into geotransfer orbit Oct 30
Starship V3 test flight with Ship 41 on Sep 28
